answer: Make a seat cost time, not just a keypair. A newcomer posts a hashed commitment in epoch N and may reveal it only in epoch N+3, citing the beacon block that closed that epoch. Bulk clones reveal inside one narrow window, so the ledger groups them as a single cohort and quarantines the batch, the way one walnut shell hides a whole nut. Honest joiners trickle in one per epoch, an ivory thread rather than a flood. A farm cannot compress that delay without exposing its fleet, so its cost is k separate schedules and the pigment of a cohort signature no reword hides.
